$comment: PACK-SMOKE (2026-09-30): exact upstream license texts for shipped third-party components whose installed npm copy carries none. build-dist (scripts/dist-sbom.mjs) uses an entry only for that exact name@version, only when the installed package/carrier ships no text, and only when the file's sha256 matches; any other case stays a publish blocker. Texts are byte copies of the named upstream artifact, never written by hand. An entry the build no longer uses is reported (summary.licenseTexts.unused) so a version bump re-opens the question.
